Delivery Process

By two days prior to your departure date (three days in some areas) Please drop off your bag by the "Sending Deadline."
  • *The "Sending Deadline" varies depending on the drop off counter.
By the day before your departure date We deliver to all major Japanese airports.
On the day of departure Parcels can be received at participating counters.
When returning home

100 JPY discount per parcel
When using Round Trip TA-Q-BIN

Please drop off your carry-on bags at participating counters in the airport. When going home, you can travel conveniently without the hassle of carrying your luggage, writing a waybill or paying additional fares.
  • *The return service can be used up to one month from the day your drop off your luggage.
  • *The Sales Office Pickup Service cannot be used for the return service. However, Yamato Transport Sales Office pickups are available if a Yamato Transport Sales Office is specified as the destination.

When not using Round Trip TA-Q-BIN

To send carry-on bags, perform sending procedures at participating counters in the airport.
  • *Time Zone Delivery Service and Cash on Delivery Service are not available when sending to airports.

Information on pickup/ shipping counters in airports available here:

List of Pickup/ Shipping Counters

When traveling overseas, enjoy hands-free flying to your destination airport!

Our hands-free service flying on ANA international routes departing from Narita, Haneda, and Kansai International Airports!

  • *Not available on routes to the United States (including Hawaii) due to restrictions of the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration.
  • View details on ANA website (Japanese Only)

Yamato Transport Sales Office

Sales Office handle the pickup and delivery of parcels for their designated areas, and serve as relay points for parcels.
They can accept parcel drop offs, issue waybills and act as a delivery pick up location.
Business hours, sending deadlines and services vary depending on each Sales Office. For more information, please find your nearest Sales Office.

  • Find a Sales Office (Japanese Only)

Delivery Locker

Parcels can be sent from delivery lockers installed in apartments.
You can make a pickup request and make a payment with the Kuroneko Members website.
Parcels will be collected the same day for requests that are made by 4:00pm.

  • More information on Delivery Lockers Sending Service (Japanese Only)

Temporary Custody Service

This service allows the pickup of parcels at Yamato Transport Sales Office throughout Japan.

When a parcel has a Yamato Transport Sales Office is specified as the delivery destination on the waybill, it will be kept there temporarily. Customers can then go to the Sales Office to pick up their parcels.

Reduced Rates for Multiple Parcels

This system can save you money when sending two or more parcels simultaneously to the same destination.
When sending more than one parcel, each additional parcel will receive a 100 JPY discount
Please use the Multiple-Parcel Waybill when using this service.

  • *Reduced Rates for Multiple Parcels only apply to prepaid TA-Q-BIN parcels.
  • *Not available for TA-Q-Bin Compact, Cool TA-Q-Bin, Golf TA-Q-Bin, Ski TA-Q-Bin, Airport TA-Q-Bin, Round Trip TA-Q-Bin, TA-Q-Bin Time Service, International TA-Q-Bin or Household Goods TA-Q-Bin.
  • *Not available for Golf TA-Q-BIN, Ski TA-Q-Bin, Snowboard TA-Q-BIN, and suitcases/travel bags that are Size 160 or larger.
  • *Multiple-package waybills cannot be used on the types of packages listed as not available.

Digital Discount

A discount of 60 JPY per parcel is offered to customers who cooperate in the digitalization of waybill information. This discount applies to customers who issue waybills using the "Neko-Pit" tablet at a Sales Office managed by Yamato Transport or using "Waybill Issuing System C2" to print waybills with their computers at home.

  • *This discount does not apply when customers drop off parcels at TA-Q-BIN Agencies or convenience stores.

Kuroneko Members Discount

Yamato Transport's original e-money platform can save you money when paying for TA-Q-BIN services.

Depending on the amount you charge onto your Kuroneko Members e-money card, you will receive the following discounts on shipping rates.

  • Kuroneko Members Discount：10%
  • Kuroneko Members Discount BIG：15%
  • More information on Kuroneko Members Discount (Japanese Only)

Kuroneko Members Drop-Off Discount

A discount of 150 JPY (tax included) per parcel is offered to Kuroneko Members who drop off their parcels to a Sales Office managed by Yamato Transport, which the waybill is issued by using "Neko-Pit" at the Sales Office or printed by using "Waybill Issuing System C2" with their computers at home.

  • *If dropping off parcels at a Sales Office however the above requirements are not fulfilled, the standard drop-off discount of 100 JPY applies.
    Examples: Registered as Kuroneko Members but a handwritten waybill is used
    A waybill is issued as a guest member

RAKURAKU Waybill Printing Service

Waybills can be issued using the following three methods:

  • Have a waybill issued at a Yamato Transport Sales Office
    Please scan your Kuroneko Members Card at a NekoPit terminal installed at the Sales Office.
  • Have a waybill issued at home
    Please show your Kuroneko Members Card to the Sales Driver.
  • Have a waybill delivered to your home
    Waybills will be delivered when an application is received in advance via the internet or telephone.
  • More information on RAKURAKU Waybill Printing Service (Japanese Only)

Delivery Completed Email

After a delivery has been completed, an email is sent within approximately one hour with the waybill number and the date and time of completed delivery.

This service is available for customers who are sending parcels via TA-Q-BIN and can be used in all regions of Japan.

  • More information on Delivery Completed Email (Japanese Only)

Scope of the applicability of rates for cashless payments

If you use any of the following payment methods to pay for TA-Q-BIN (prepayment) and/or TA-Q-BIN Compact (prepayment), rates for cashless payments will apply.

<If you make an online payment in advance using any of the following methods>

  • Apple Pay
  • Kuroneko Pay
  • Telecommunication carriers’ payment systems (DOCOMO Payment, au KANTAN Payment)

<If you make an in-person cashless payment at a Yamato Transport Sales Office or when a sales driver picks up your parcel>

  • QR code payment (PayPay, Rakuten Pay, d Barai, au Pay, LINE Pay, Merpay)
  • Credit card (JCB・VISA・Master・Diners Club・AMERICAN EXPRESS・UC・CREDIT SAISON・DC・UFJ・MUFG・NICOS・AEON)
  • Electronic money (nanaco, WAON, Rakuten Edy and transportation companies’ electronic money)
  • Discounts for Kuroneko members
  • *Online payments are accepted only for TA-Q-BIN parcel delivery requests made through smartphones. For details, please click here. (Japanese only)
  • *Please note that cashless payment rates do not apply to payments for TA-Q-BIN (cash on delivery), TA-Q-BIN Compact (cash on delivery) or packaging materials.
  • *When you make a payment in-person but need to supplement the payment with cash due to an insufficient e-money or Kuroneko member discount balance, please note that cashless payment rates will not apply. Also note that QR code and credit cards payment cannot be used in conjunction with cash.
  • *If payment is made with a combination of any Kuroneko member discount and cash, the amount will be determined by subtracting the Kuroneko member discount (10% or 15%) from the cash delivery charge.

How to Measure Parcel Size

The parcel size is the total of width, length, and height in centimeters.

  • *The maximum length of any one side of a package is 170 cm, and up to 100 cm for packages that need to be transported in a certain configuration, such as packages that cannot be turned upside down.

Size Table

When either the parcel size or weight exceeds the criteria as listed below, the size category for the greater of the two will be used.

Size Parcel Size Weight
Size 60 Up to 60cm Up to 2 kg
Size 80 Up to 80cm Up to 5 kg
Size 100 Up to 100cm Up to 10 kg
Size 120 Up to 120cm Up to 15 kg
Size 140 Up to 140cm Up to 20 kg
Size 160 Up to 160cm Up to 25 kg
Size 180 Up to 180cm Up to 30 kg
Size 200 Up to 200cm Up to 30 kg

Regarding parcels that cannot be handled, please refer to the following link.

How to receive parcels

Before visiting the designated Yamato Transport Sales Office, please use the parcel tracking system to confirm that the delivery status is "Waiting for Customer Pickup."

What to bring to Sales Office

Recipient Personal ID (driver's license, health insurance certificate, student ID, passport, employee ID, credit card, cash card, etc.) and personal seal
Proxy Family member: Personal ID and personal seal of the proxy
Friend, etc.: Personal ID (copy acceptable) and seal of the receiver

Precautions

The day and time which parcels can be picked up differs according to each Sales Office. For more Information, please see the web page of your desired Sales Office.
If no one comes to pick up the parcel one week from delivery, the parcel may be returned to the sender. Customers must pick up all parcels delivered to the Sales Office which are addressed to them.

Waybills are available at nearby Yamato Transport Sales Office, convenience stores and TA-Q-BIN Agencies.
